content.text: 5 Key Takeaways From ‘Noah Kahan: Out of Body’ Netflix DocumentaryThe new Netflix documentary Noah Kahan: Out of Body offers an intimate look at singer-songwriter Noah Kahan. The documentary traces his rise from indie-folk favorite to global success after Stick Season, while also revealing the emotional cost of his fame. Released on April 13 on Netflix, the documentary came days before his upcoming album The Great Divide.Directed by Nick Sweeney, the documentary captures Kahan at what he calls an “in-between” stage: caught between surreal fame and a quieter inner life. As he begins working on new music in his hometown, the film reveals how pressure, family history, and self-perception collide behind the scenes of success.
